BiblicalUsage: gongysmós means grudging, murmuring. In John 7:12, the text says "And there was much murmuring among the people concerning him." In Acts 6:1, the text says "there arose a murmuring of the Grecians against the Hebrews."
TheologicalSignificance: gongysmós convinces me that sin is not a mistake; it is rebellion, and it needs a Saviour, not an excuse. That is why I keep this word in mind when I read those passages — it carries more than its size suggests.
RelatedEvents: Martyrdom of Stephen; The Appointment of the Seven
